levels.surface: أحمد بن علي بن إبراهيم بن هاشم

notes: the three names in the opening are co-transmitters of one level, joined to علي بن إبراهيم by «قالوا حدثنا»
«عن أبيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link written with its name (rule 7); «رضي الله عنهم» and «عليهم السلام» are left out
the Imams named inside the chain after «عن» stay narrators; the Prophet is not a link

fixes.reason: THQ's English adds «Ali» before Ma'bad; the Arabic writes only «معبد»

evidence.quote: on the authority of Ali ibn Ma’bad
